note: Transcribed from MetricsReportSchema (the report envelope) and UserMetricsRecordSchema (one NDJSON line) in server/reconciliation/adapters/github-client.ts. This records what TokenScope ASSUMES, not what has been observed. `ndjson_records` is NOT a key GitHub sends: it is the probe's own name for the downloaded NDJSON file's lines, which arrive as a separate HTTP response and have no place in the envelope. UserMetricsRecordSchema declares four fields — user_login, user_id, day, ai_credits_used — and no model dimension, so none is declared here; whether one arrives is answered by the undeclared-paths section of a live run, not by this file. Copilot meters in AI credits rather than tokens, so a model dimension may or may not exist on this surface; the baseline takes no position either way. The record schema is .passthrough(), so every field the wire carries beyond these four survives into the report as undeclared.
